Name: Kimberly's Witch Bed and Crib for Alternative Textures and Content Patcher
Author: glymr
Description:
A conversion of the bed and crib from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1375]Kimberly's Witch.Kitchen.Bed.Bathroom.Crib[/url] to Alternative Textures and Content Patcher, created and uploaded with permission. This mod is for the double bed and the crib portions of the original mod. For the kitchen and farmhouse interior, please see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28969]this mod[/url]. Iceprincess98 also made a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29147]beautiful PIF conversion of the bathroom[/url] from the original mod.

The double bed is available in both Alternative Textures and Content Patcher versions of this mod. The crib is available in the Content Patcher version only. Both versions can be installed on the same save without conflict. [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Iceprincess98/mods]Iceprincess98[/url] created the CP version and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/glymr/mods]glymr[/url] created the AT version.

For the bed, we also added options for a white headboard for the purple bed and a black headboard for the pink bed. There are now four options total.

With the CP version of the mod you can purchase the double beds from Robin or get them for free from the furniture catalog. You can also independently configure if you want the crib to appear in the farmhouse, the cabins, or both.

The AT version is only for the vanilla double bed. Use the paint can purchasable from Robin to change the vanilla double bed's design.

According to the original mod, portions of their assets were based on [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/432/?]Witchy-Gothic Interior UPDATED FOR 1.1[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/854/?tab=3&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmodimages%2F%3Fuser%3D0%26id%3D854%26gid%3D1303]Classy new interior[/url] tiles and re-edited.

If you like this mod, it would make us very happy if you would endorse it. <3  Thank you!

Check out iceprincess98's mods [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Iceprincess98/mods]here[/url], including updates of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28244]Witchy-Gothic Interior[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14836]Missy's Shirts[/url]!

Check out glymr's mods [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/glymr/mods?gameId=1303]here[/url], including [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21147]Place Furniture Outside[/url], a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19304]Better Slime Hutch[/url] interior, and customizable [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16751]Animal Growth[/url] times.

(All our mods are compatible with 1.6)
